Project: Two files in a folder

This lesson serves the criterion "create the files a task names and see the check pass": make two files in the folder teach-0001, then see every requirement of the check reported ok.

Reset the task's folder, make the files, then run the check. The check asserts three requirements:

  • The file teach-0001/a.txt exists.
  • The file teach-0001/b.txt exists.
  • The file teach-0001/b.txt holds the word hello.
evidence/0001/setup.sh
./check 1

The check prints one line for each requirement. This check fails on a fresh setup and passes after the reference solution. [2]
